For the April 2026 reporting period on the Multi-purpose building (demo) project, the office entered 68 percent complete. 

Based on the photos, the 100 percent claim for the rooftop level enclosure (walls and cladding) is contradicted, as it is visible in the frame. 

The photos cannot show the roof waterproofing because it is hidden work that cannot be seen from the camera. The street hoarding replacement is also not visible enough in the frame to tell. Street level is blurred in this copy, so the main entrance canopy cannot be seen. 

This note decides nothing about payment. Please follow up on the main entrance canopy during the next site visit.

For the Multi-purpose building (demo) April 2026 report, the office entered 68% complete. Photos contradict the 100% claim for the rooftop level enclosure walls and cladding, which are visible in the frame. The camera cannot confirm the remaining claims because the street hoarding is not visible enough, the main entrance canopy is blurred, and the roof waterproofing is hidden work.

This is a progress update for the Multi-purpose building (demo) project for April 2026, with 68% complete entered by the office. This note describes only what the photos show and cannot show, and it decides nothing about payment. 

The rooftop level enclosure walls and cladding are visible in the frame. Other items cannot be confirmed from the images. The street level is blurred in this copy, so the main entrance canopy cannot be seen and must be checked on the next site visit. The street hoarding replacement is not visible enough in this frame to confirm. Roof waterproofing is hidden work that cannot be seen from the camera.
